text:
lina-partners: Quick post-launch sync — pilot rollout for Snowflake + Databricks + vector connector is live for 5 pilot accounts. Need an oncall + launch playbook for first 72h. Who takes which item?

priya-product: I can own GTM comms and announcement cadence. Draft email + marketplace banner by EOD.

tom-eng-runtime: Oncall runbook updated in the repo. Added health endpoints and a short run play: /internal/connector/health and /internal/connector/metrics. Also added a streaming debug flag.

asha-soleng: I'll put together the customer-facing KB and step-by-step troubleshooting. Will include error patterns + mitigations.

miguel-sre: Adding an alert for connector_error_rate and high-latency tail. Proposed alert:
```
query: sum(rate(connector_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(connector_requests_total[5m])) > 0.005
action: page @oncall -> escalates to SRE after 2 pages
```
Can someone confirm the labels we should rely on? (env, model_version, connector)

kevin-field: Sales asked for a one-pager on known limitations (regional availability, max QPS per tenant, cold-start latency). Priya can you make that PSA part of the GTM pack? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deployment completed: release/connector-snow-dbx-v1.2.3 by @tom-eng-runtime :rocket:

Tom-eng-runtime: quick note — pushed a log-rotation fix and a defensive guard for KV cache OOMs. If you see repeated "kv-cache oom" in logs, set debug flag and collect /var/log/connector-core.log. Example curl health check:
```bash
curl -fsS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://connector.internal.redwood/api/internal/connector/health
```

miguel-sre: Confirmed alerts, I updated threshold to 0.5% error rate and added a latency P95 > 800ms rule for 10m. Also enabling read-replica backups for us-west-2.

asha-soleng: KB draft uploaded: https://redwood.help/marketplace/snow-dbx-vector — includes steps, sample ingestion SQL, and recovery steps. Please review.

lina-partners: Summary checklist: 1) GTM & PSA (Priya) 2) Support KB (Asha) 3) Alerts + oncall (Miguel) 4) Field one-pager (Kevin) 5) Follow-up postmortem + telemetry run in 7 days. I'll collate owners and circulate the playbook to partners list. :white_check_mark:

priya-product: Added marketing sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to align message and customer email. I'll cc legal on the PSA wording.

kevin-field: Noted. I'll prep a short demo and FAQ for AE enablement — target Thursday.

lina-partners: Great. If anyone sees replication lag or increased error churn, ping here and @oncall. Thanks all.

tom-eng-runtime: noted and watching logs.

miguel-sre: I'll create the incident channel if alerts trigger and invite ops + eng.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Canary metrics dashboard link -> https://dash.redwood.prod/canary/connector-snow-dbx

lina-partners: Perfect. Closing sync for now — will post the combined playbook in the channel when it's ready. :party:
